sloka: खर बाहु प्रमुक्ता सा प्रदीप्ता महती गदा ।भस्म वृक्षाम् च गुल्माम् च कृत्वा अगात् तत् समीपतः ॥३-२९-२६॥
transliteration: khara bāhu pramuktā sā pradīptā mahatī gadā ।bhasma vṛkṣām ca gulmām ca kṛtvā agāt tat samīpataḥ ॥3-29-26॥

translations.english: The huge, blazing mace hurled by Khara's arms reduced the trees and shrubs into ashes and came close to Rama.
